title: A topic of a domain's rules
description: docs/rules/<topic>.yaml in a domain folder: the rules about one topic, as they hold today (ADR 0016). How they got there is in docs/decisions/; the rulebook in docs/rulebook/ is generated from these files.

title.description: The topic's name, as the rulebook heads it.

canvas.description: The parts of the Bounded Context Canvas that must be written. The commands in, the events out and the policies are derived from the model when the rulebook is generated.

purpose.description: What this part of the domain is for, in a sentence or two.

packages.description: The model's packages this topic is about (ADR 0013); checked against the model.

types.description: Types this topic is about outside those packages; checked against the model. A cross-cutting topic names neither.

id.description: Any id without spaces, unique across the domain's rules, questions and drawing issues (R12). The platform gives ids no shape.

title.description: One line: what the rule says.

kind.description: definitional: what something is (a request has one route per lab its samples go to). behavioural: what must or may happen (a sample past its stability is not run). table: a decision table, given in `table`.

status.description: agreed: the domain owner agreed it. to-confirm: built on a leaning the owner has not yet confirmed. deferred: left out on purpose, so it is not mistaken for a gap. superseded: replaced by a newer rule that says `supersedes:` it.

text.description: The rule as it holds today, in the domain's words. When a newer rule revises this one, this text is rewritten to what still holds; the old wording stays in the decision log.

table.description: For kind: table — the decision table: one column per input and outcome, one row per case.

refines.description: Earlier rules this one adds to; both hold. Said only here — the back-link is derived.

revises.description: Earlier rules this one changes part of; their text is rewritten to what still holds. Said only here — the back-link is derived.

supersedes.description: Earlier rules this one replaces; each must have status: superseded. Said only here — the back-link is derived.

decided.description: Where it was decided: the session's log in docs/decisions/, and the questions it answers.

session.description: The number of the log, docs/decisions/NN-<date>-<what>.md.

untraced.description: Why no model element or no scenario cites this rule, when that is right (a statement about the organisation, nothing to build). Without it, an agreed or to-confirm rule nothing cites is a finding.

release.description: the release of the lab system it is built in
